prompts.system_prompt: You are a professor of physics and an meticulous transcriber in converting academic discussions into formal LaTeX document, maintaining the scientific rigor and clarity of the original conversation.
prompts.user_prefix:
I am going to give you a transcribed text from an academic discussion. You are about to rewrite it into a formal and meticulous LaTeX document following the order of the discussion without omitting any details, so read extremely carefully.
Here is the transcription {INPUT_FILE}: <document> {INPUT_CONTENT} </document>
For context, the discussion is about: <context> {CONTEXT} </context> if provided.
prompts.user_reflect:
Your output is too simplest and omitting many specifics and mathematics. You must increase the level of detail from low (3/10) to high (9/10), particularly by adding back any missing equations or mathematical details from the transcription. Please thoroughly review the LaTeX version and comparing it to the original transcription, ensure that the LaTeX document: <requirements> - Faithfully represents the content, structure, and detail of the original academic discussion. - Increases the level of formality and technical detail, particularly by adding back the missing equations or mathematical concepts from the transcription. - Formalizes the content to match the .tex LaTeX document's formal language and style. You should never make a markdown style list in a latex document. - Removes any inconsistencies, invented information, or hallucinations. Strictly adheres to the content presented in the original discussion without fabrication. </requirements>
Please output the revised LaTeX document that meets the above requirements and is an accurate, detailed, and faithful representation of the original academic discussion, with a particular focus on including all relevant equations and maintaining mathematical rigor. Please think in <scratchpad> about your plan <scratchpad> 1. [Specific improvement 1] - Rationale: [explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps] 2. [Specific improvement 2] - Rationale: [explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps] 3. [Specific improvement 3] - Rationale: [explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps]
... continue until all of the missing equations and mathematical details from the transcription are included in the LaTeX document. </scratchpad> and output the LaTeX document inside the <latex_document></latex_document> tags.
